swift.module.zoom.name: Zoom
swift.module.zoom.desc: Hold the zoom key to zoom in (scroll to adjust).
swift.module.zoom.setting.controls.name: Zoom key
swift.module.zoom.setting.controls.desc: Change it in Options > Controls > Key Binds, under Swift Client.
swift.module.zoom.setting.mode.name: Mode
swift.module.zoom.setting.mode.desc: Hold the key, or press once to toggle the zoom on and off.
swift.module.zoom.setting.duration.name: Smooth duration
swift.module.zoom.setting.duration.desc: How long the zoom takes to reach its target. Shorter feels snappier, longer feels cinematic.
swift.module.zoom.setting.smooth.name: Smooth transition
swift.module.zoom.setting.smooth.desc: Ease in and out instead of snapping to the zoomed view.
swift.module.zoom.setting.fov.name: Zoom FOV
swift.module.zoom.setting.fov.desc: Field of view while zoomed. The lower the value, the closer it gets.
swift.module.fullbright.name: FullBright
swift.module.fullbright.desc: See in the dark as in broad daylight. Capped under shaders: beyond that the screen turns red.
swift.module.fullbright.setting.level.de: How far the darkness is lifted. Capped automatically when a shader pack is loaded, because going further turns the whole scene red.
swift.module.togglesprint.name: Toggle Sprint
swift.module.togglesprint.desc: Press the Sprint key once to sprint, once more to stop.
swift.module.togglesneak.name: Toggle Sneak
swift.module.togglesneak.desc: Press the Sneak key once to stay crouched, once more to stand up.
swift.module.autojump.name: Auto Jump
swift.module.vanillaui.name: Vanilla UI
swift.module.vanillaui.desc: Hides the Swift Client buttons and 3D skin from the main menu (mod compatibility).
swift.module.blockoverlay.name: Block Outline
swift.module.blockoverlay.desc: Recolor or hide the outline of the block you are looking at.
swift.module.blockoverlay.setting.mode.d: Draw the outline of the block you are looking at in your colour, or hide it.
swift.module.hud_date.name: Date
swift.module.hud_date.desc: HUD element - move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_clock.name: Clock
swift.module.hud_clock.desc: HUD element - move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_days.name: Day counter
swift.module.hud_days.desc: HUD element - move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_coords.name: Coordinates
swift.module.hud_coords.desc: HUD element - move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_effects.name: Potion Effects
swift.module.hud_effects.desc: HUD element - move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_tnt.name: TNT Countdown
swift.module.hud_tnt.desc: Fuse time of lit TNT, on screen and above the TNT itself. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_music.name: Now playing
swift.module.hud_music.desc: Current track (Spotify, browser, any Windows media). Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_music.setting.cover.des: Show the album artwork on the left of the panel.
swift.module.hud_music.setting.artist.de: Show the artist under the track title.
swift.module.hud_music.setting.time.name: Show time
swift.module.hud_music.setting.time.desc: Show the elapsed time and the track length.
Draw a progress bar under the title.
Show previous / play / next buttons. They act on the player that is running.
Show the next track in the queue. Spotify only, and needs the account linked below.
swift.module.hud_music.setting.spotify.d: Link a Spotify account to read the queue and control playback.
swift.module.hud_music.setting.glass.des: Frosted background that blurs the scene behind the panel.
swift.module.hud_music.setting.blur.name: Glass blur
swift.module.hud_music.setting.blur.desc: How strongly the scene behind the panel is blurred.
swift.module.hud_music.setting.opacity.d: How opaque the panel background is.
swift.module.hud_music.setting.bloom.des: Halo picked from the album artwork, spread around the panel.
swift.module.hud_music.setting.col_sub.d: Colour of the artist and of the times.
Colour of the filled part of the progress bar.
swift.module.hud_fps.name: FPS
swift.module.hud_fps.desc: Frames per second. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_fps.setting.label.name: Show "FPS" label
swift.module.hud_fps.setting.label.desc: Prefix the number with the word "FPS".
swift.module.hud_fps.setting.smooth.name: Smoothed value
swift.module.hud_fps.setting.smooth.desc: Average the value over a second. The raw counter jumps too much to read.
swift.module.hud_fps.setting.colored.des: Green above 60, orange in the middle, red below 30.
swift.module.hud_memory.name: Memory
swift.module.hud_memory.desc: Used memory. Move it in the HUD Editor.
Show the share of the allocated memory that is in use.
swift.module.hud_memory.setting.max.name: Show allocated
swift.module.hud_memory.setting.max.desc: Also show how much memory the game was given in total.
swift.module.hud_memory.setting.bar.name: Usage bar
swift.module.hud_memory.setting.bar.desc: Draw a fill bar under the numbers.
Turn orange then red as the memory fills up.
swift.module.hud_biome.name: Biome
swift.module.hud_biome.desc: Current biome. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_biome.setting.label.des: Prefix the biome name with the word "Biome".
swift.module.hud_speed.name: Speed
swift.module.hud_speed.desc: Movement speed. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_speed.setting.unit.name: Unit
swift.module.hud_speed.setting.unit.desc: Metres per second, or kilometres per hour.
Count falling and climbing as speed, not just horizontal movement.
How many digits after the decimal point.
swift.module.hud_speed.setting.label.des: Show the unit next to the number.
swift.module.hud_cps.name: CPS
swift.module.hud_cps.desc: Clicks per second. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_cps.setting.button.name: Button
swift.module.hud_cps.setting.button.desc: Which mouse button is counted: left, right, or both added together.
swift.module.hud_cps.setting.label.name: Show "CPS" label
swift.module.hud_cps.setting.label.desc: Prefix the number with the word "CPS".
swift.module.hud_keystrokes.name: Keystrokes
swift.module.hud_keystrokes.desc: Movement keys and mouse buttons. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_keystrokes.setting.mous: Show the two mouse buttons under the movement keys.
Write the clicks per second inside each mouse button.
swift.module.hud_keystrokes.setting.spac: Show the space bar under the other keys.
swift.module.hud_keystrokes.setting.snea: Show the sneak key. Off by default: it is rarely the one you watch.
swift.module.hud_keystrokes.setting.size: Side of one key square, in pixels.
swift.module.hud_keystrokes.setting.pres: Colour of a key while it is held down.
swift.module.hud_keystrokes.setting.idle: Colour of a key at rest. Lower the alpha to make it discreet.
swift.module.hud_armor.name: Armor Status
swift.module.hud_armor.desc: Equipped armor as item icons. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_armor.setting.layout.de: Arrange the four pieces in a row or in a column.
swift.module.hud_armor.setting.durabilit: What to show under each piece: nothing, a bar, a percentage or the raw value.
swift.module.hud_armor.setting.held.name: Show held item
swift.module.hud_armor.setting.held.desc: Also show the item currently in your hand, next to the armour.
swift.module.hud_armor.setting.backgroun: Draw a dark panel behind the icons so they stay readable on a bright sky.
swift.module.hud_scoreboard.name: Scoreboard
swift.module.hud_scoreboard.desc: Move, resize and restyle the server scoreboard. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_scoreboard.setting.numb: Show the red score numbers on the right of each line.
swift.module.hud_scoreboard.setting.back: Draw a panel behind the lines.
swift.module.hud_scoreboard.setting.bg_c: Colour of that panel. The alpha sets how much of the world shows through.
swift.module.discord_rpc.name: Discord RPC
swift.module.discord_rpc.desc: Show Swift Client and what you are doing in your Discord status.
swift.module.discord_rpc.setting.hide_ip: Show "On a server" instead of the server address, so your status never gives away where you play.
swift.module.crosshair.name: Crosshair
swift.module.crosshair.setting.edit.name: Pixel editor
swift.module.crosshair.setting.size.name: Length
swift.module.crosshair.setting.gap.name: Gap
swift.module.crosshair.setting.dot.name: Center dot
swift.module.freelook.name: Freelook
swift.module.freelook.desc: Hold a key to look around without turning your player.
swift.module.freelook.setting.controls.d: Change it in Options > Controls > Key Binds, under Swift Client.
swift.module.gui_blur.name: Menu Blur
swift.module.gui_blur.desc: Blurs the game behind open menus and inventories.
swift.module.friends.name: Friends
swift.module.friends.desc: Your Swift friends, shared with the launcher: find them in game and know when they come online.
swift.module.friends.setting.manage.name: Friends list
swift.module.friends.setting.manage.desc: Add or remove friends. The list is the same as in the launcher.
swift.module.friends.setting.glow.name: Outline in world
swift.module.friends.setting.glow.desc: Draw an outline around your friends, even through walls.
swift.module.friends.setting.tab_star.de: Put a gold star in front of your friends in the player list.
swift.module.friends.setting.notify.name: Online alerts
swift.module.friends.setting.notify.desc: Show a notification when a friend comes online (needs the Notifications module).
swift.module.hud_minimap.name: Minimap
swift.module.hud_minimap.desc: Map of the terrain around you, with players and waypoints. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_minimap.setting.size.de: Side of the map on screen.
How many blocks are shown from you to the edge.
Keep where you look at the top. Off: north stays at the top.
Write your position under the map.
swift.module.hud_minimap.setting.players: Mark the other players around you.
swift.module.hud_minimap.setting.color.d: Colour of the arrow that stands for you.
swift.module.waypoints.name: Waypoints
swift.module.waypoints.desc: Mark places and find them again: a beam and a label with the distance.
swift.module.waypoints.setting.key.name: Add key
swift.module.waypoints.setting.key.desc: Press it to drop a waypoint at your feet. Change it in Options > Controls > Key Binds.
swift.module.waypoints.setting.name.name: Next waypoint name
swift.module.waypoints.setting.name.desc: Name given to the next waypoint. Empty: "Waypoint 1", "Waypoint 2"...
swift.module.waypoints.setting.add.name: Add here
swift.module.waypoints.setting.add.desc: Drop a waypoint where you stand.
swift.module.waypoints.setting.remove.de: Delete the waypoint closest to you.
swift.module.waypoints.setting.clear.des: Delete every waypoint of this server or world.
swift.module.waypoints.setting.beam.name: Beam
swift.module.waypoints.setting.beam.desc: Draw a vertical beam on each waypoint so you see it from afar.
Waypoints further than this are hidden.
swift.module.motion_blur.name: Motion Blur
swift.module.motion_blur.desc: Leaves a light trail when you turn, for a smoother, cinematic feel.
swift.module.motion_blur.setting.strengt: How much of the previous frames stays visible. High values smear a lot.
swift.module.hud_pvpinfo.name: PvP Info
swift.module.hud_pvpinfo.desc: Card about who you are fighting: head, health, armour and distance. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_pvpinfo.setting.distanc: Write how far your opponent is.
swift.module.hud_pvpinfo.setting.armor.d: Write the armour points of your opponent.
swift.module.hud_combo.name: Combo Counter
swift.module.hud_combo.desc: Hits landed in a row without being hit back. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_combo.setting.hide_zero: Only show the counter once you land a hit.
swift.module.hud_combo.setting.color.des: Colour of the counter from 3 hits in a row.
swift.module.saturation.name: Color Saturation
swift.module.saturation.desc: Makes the world more vivid or more washed out, with contrast and brightness. The HUD is not affected.
swift.module.saturation.setting.saturati: 100% is vanilla, 0% is black and white, 200% is very vivid.
swift.module.saturation.setting.contrast: 100% is vanilla. Higher darkens shadows and brightens highlights.
swift.module.item_physics.name: Item Physics
swift.module.item_physics.desc: Dropped items tumble as they fall, then lie flat on the ground instead of spinning in the air.
swift.module.hud_direction.name: Direction HUD
swift.module.hud_direction.desc: A compass strip showing where you are heading. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_direction.setting.degre: Write the exact heading under the strip.
swift.module.hud_direction.setting.backg: Draw a dark panel behind the strip.
swift.module.time_changer.name: Time Changer
swift.module.time_changer.desc: Shows the world at the time you choose. Only on your screen: the server keeps its own time.
swift.module.time_changer.setting.hour.d: Time of day to show: 6h sunrise, 12h noon, 18h sunset, 0h midnight.
swift.module.time_changer.setting.frozen: Stay at that hour. Off: the day goes on from there at normal speed.
swift.module.nametags.name: NameTags
swift.module.nametags.desc: Name tags above players: yours in third person, bigger or smaller, with or without background.
swift.module.nametags.setting.own.name: Show your own
swift.module.nametags.setting.own.desc: See your own name tag in third person view.
swift.module.nametags.setting.scale.name: Size
swift.module.nametags.setting.scale.desc: Size of the name tags. 100% is vanilla.
swift.module.nametags.setting.background: Opacity of the dark box behind names. 0% removes it.
swift.module.chunk_borders.name: Chunk Borders
swift.module.chunk_borders.desc: Outlines the chunk you are standing in, without opening F3.
swift.module.chunk_borders.setting.color: Colour of the walls of your chunk.
Mark every 2 blocks on the walls, to count easily.
swift.module.chunk_borders.setting.neigh: Also draw the corners of the chunks around yours.
swift.module.chunk_borders.setting.heigh: How many blocks above and below you the walls reach.
swift.module.fog.name: Fog Customizer
swift.module.fog.desc: Push back or remove the fog: render distance, weather, water and lava. Recolour it if you like.
swift.module.fog.setting.distance.name: Remove distance fog
swift.module.fog.setting.distance.desc: No fog at the edge of your render distance.
swift.module.fog.setting.density.name: Weather fog
swift.module.fog.setting.density.desc: Distance of the fog of rain, the Nether and the End. 100% is vanilla, 300% pushes it 3 times further, 0% keeps it very close.
swift.module.fog.setting.water.name: Clear water
swift.module.fog.setting.water.desc: Remove most of the fog under water.
swift.module.fog.setting.lava.name: Clear lava
swift.module.fog.setting.lava.desc: See further when you are in lava.
swift.module.fog.setting.tint.name: Custom color
swift.module.fog.setting.tint.desc: Replace the fog colour with yours.
swift.module.fog.setting.color.name: Fog color
swift.module.fog.setting.color.desc: Colour of the fog when Custom color is on.
swift.module.hud_reach.name: Reach Display
swift.module.hud_reach.desc: Distance of your last hit. Move it in the HUD Editor.
How many digits after the decimal point.
swift.module.hud_bossbar.name: Boss Bar
swift.module.hud_bossbar.desc: Replaces the boss bars with movable, resizable Swift bars. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_bossbar.setting.title.d: Write the boss name above each bar.
swift.module.hud_bossbar.setting.max.des: How many boss bars can be shown at once.
swift.module.hud_bossbar.setting.own_col: Use your colour instead of the one chosen by the server.
swift.module.hud_bossbar.setting.color.d: Colour of the bars when Custom color is on.
swift.module.hit_color.name: Hit Color
swift.module.hit_color.desc: Changes the colour entities flash when they take damage.
swift.module.hit_color.setting.color.des: Flash colour. The alpha sets how strong the flash is.
swift.module.particles.name: Particle Changer
swift.module.particles.desc: More hit particles, fewer distracting ones: explosions, block debris, rain, potion swirls.
swift.module.particles.setting.crits.des: Critical hit particles on every hit you land.
swift.module.particles.setting.sharpness: Blue enchanted-hit particles on every hit you land.
swift.module.particles.setting.multiplie: How many bursts of hit particles each hit makes.
swift.module.particles.setting.blocks.de: No particles when blocks are mined or broken.
swift.module.particles.setting.rain.name: Hide rain splashes
swift.module.particles.setting.rain.desc: No splash particles where rain lands.
swift.module.particles.setting.potions.d: No swirls around entities under potion effects.
swift.module.snaplook.name: Snaplook
swift.module.snaplook.desc: Hold a key to glance behind you in third person, release to come back.
swift.module.snaplook.setting.key.name: Snaplook key
swift.module.snaplook.setting.key.desc: Change it in Options > Controls > Key Binds, under Swift Client.
swift.module.snaplook.setting.view.name: View
swift.module.snaplook.setting.view.desc: Front: the camera faces you, to see who follows. Back: classic third person.
swift.module.worldedit_cui.name: WorldEdit CUI
swift.module.worldedit_cui.desc: Shows your WorldEdit selection on servers running WorldEdit (wand, //pos1, //pos2).
Tint the inside of the selection lightly.
swift.module.old_visuals.name: 1.7 Visuals
swift.module.old_visuals.desc: Brings back the 1.7 / 1.8 look: no hand dip after each hit, armour flashing red with its wearer.
Your item stays up after a hit instead of lowering while the attack recharges.
swift.module.old_visuals.setting.red_arm: Armour turns red with the player or mob wearing it when they are hurt.
swift.module.hud_ping.name: Ping
swift.module.hud_ping.desc: Your latency to the server. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_ping.setting.label.name: Show "ms"
swift.module.hud_ping.setting.label.desc: Write the unit after the number.
swift.module.hud_ping.setting.colored.de: Green under 80 ms, orange up to 160 ms, red above.
swift.module.hud_ping.setting.singleplay: Keep the element on screen even when there is no server to measure.
swift.module.uhc_overlay.name: UHC Overlay
swift.module.uhc_overlay.desc: Golden apples, heads, gold and diamonds on the ground are drawn bigger so you spot them.
swift.module.uhc_overlay.setting.size.de: How much bigger the highlighted items are drawn.
swift.module.uhc_overlay.setting.ores.de: Also enlarge gold ingots, nuggets, raw gold and diamonds, not only apples and heads.
swift.module.hud_itemcounter.name: Item Counter
swift.module.hud_itemcounter.desc: How many arrows, pearls, golden apples, potions, totems and blocks you carry. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_itemcounter.setting.arr: Count arrows, tipped and spectral ones included.
swift.module.hud_itemcounter.setting.gap: Count golden apples, enchanted ones included.
swift.module.hud_itemcounter.setting.blo: Count every placeable block, for bridging.
swift.module.hud_itemcounter.setting.lay: Arrange the counters in a row or in a column.
swift.module.hud_itemcounter.setting.hid: Do not show a counter at zero.
swift.module.hud_itemcounter.setting.bac: Draw a dark panel behind the counters.
swift.module.clear_glass.name: Clear Glass
swift.module.clear_glass.desc: Glass without streaks: only a thin frame, and an even, lighter tint on stained glass.
swift.module.team_view.name: Team View
swift.module.team_view.desc: Find your teammates at a glance: outline through walls and a marker with their distance.
swift.module.team_view.setting.glow.name: Outline teammates
swift.module.team_view.setting.glow.desc: Outline your teammates in their team colour, even behind blocks.
swift.module.team_view.setting.markers.d: Write the name and distance of each teammate above them, through walls.
swift.module.team_view.setting.friends.d: Treat your Swift friends as teammates on servers without teams.
swift.module.hud_cooldowns.name: Cooldowns
swift.module.hud_cooldowns.desc: Items you cannot use yet (pearls, chorus fruit, shield...) with the time left. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_cooldowns.setting.backg: Draw a dark panel behind the items.
swift.module.hud_cooldowns.setting.color: Colour of the bar that drains under each item.
swift.module.weather_changer.name: Weather Changer
swift.module.weather_changer.desc: Choose the weather you see: clear, rain (snow in cold biomes) or thunderstorm. The server keeps its own.
swift.module.weather_changer.setting.wea: What you see, whatever the server weather is.
swift.module.hud_server.name: Server Address
swift.module.hud_server.desc: The address of the server you are on. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_server.setting.icon.des: Draw a globe before the address.
swift.module.hud_server.setting.singlepl: Write "Singleplayer" when you are not on a server.
swift.module.light_overlay.name: Light Overlay
swift.module.light_overlay.desc: Marks the blocks where mobs can spawn: red always, yellow at night.
swift.module.light_overlay.setting.range: How many blocks around you are checked.
swift.module.light_overlay.setting.night: Also mark the blocks lit by the sky only (yellow), where mobs spawn at night.
swift.module.hitboxes.name: Hitboxes
swift.module.hitboxes.desc: Shows entity hitboxes, coloured by kind, and the direction each one looks.
swift.module.hitboxes.setting.mobs.name: Mobs
swift.module.hitboxes.setting.items.name: Dropped items
swift.module.hitboxes.setting.items.desc: Outline items lying on the ground.
swift.module.hitboxes.setting.look.name: Look direction
swift.module.hitboxes.setting.look.desc: Draw a short line showing where players and mobs look.
Colour of mob, item and projectile hitboxes.
swift.module.hitboxes.setting.range.name: Range
swift.module.hitboxes.setting.range.desc: Entities further than this are skipped.
swift.module.hud_notifications.name: Notifications
swift.module.hud_notifications.desc: Swift toasts: friends coming online, screenshots saved... Move them in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_notifications.setting.d: How long a notification stays on screen.
swift.module.hud_notifications.setting.f: Tell you when one of your Swift friends comes online.
swift.module.hud_itemtracker.name: Item Tracker
swift.module.hud_itemtracker.desc: A feed of the items you pick up. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_itemtracker.setting.dur: How long each line stays on screen.
swift.module.hud_itemtracker.setting.los: Also list the items that leave your inventory (dropped, used, crafted).
swift.module.items_2d.name: 2D Items
swift.module.items_2d.desc: Dropped items are drawn flat and always face you, easier to read from afar.
swift.module.hud_tnt.setting.world.name: Above the TNT
swift.module.hud_tnt.setting.world.desc: Write the seconds left above every lit TNT near you.
swift.module.tab_editor.name: Tab Editor
swift.module.tab_editor.desc: Reshape the player list: more columns, ping in ms, slide-in animation.
How many columns the player list may use. Vanilla stops at 4, so big servers get cut.
swift.module.tab_editor.setting.ping_num: Write each player's latency in milliseconds instead of the signal bars.
swift.module.tab_editor.setting.slide.de: The list slides in from the top when you press Tab.
swift.module.chat.name: Chat
swift.module.chat.desc: Timestamps, repeated messages stacked into one line, longer history kept when you change server.
swift.module.chat.setting.timestamps.des: Write the time in front of every message.
swift.module.chat.setting.seconds.name: Show seconds
swift.module.chat.setting.stack.name: Stack repeats
swift.module.chat.setting.stack.desc: A message sent several times in a row shows once, with [x3].
swift.module.chat.setting.history.name: History size
swift.module.chat.setting.history.desc: How many messages you can scroll back. Vanilla keeps 100.
swift.module.chat.setting.keep.name: Keep on disconnect
swift.module.chat.setting.keep.desc: Keep the chat history when you leave a server or a world.
swift.module.hide_foliage.name: Hide Foliage
swift.module.hide_foliage.desc: Hides tall grass, ferns, bushes and flowers for a clear view of the ground and more FPS.
swift.module.hud_stopwatch.name: Stopwatch
swift.module.hud_stopwatch.desc: A stopwatch on your HUD, started and paused with a key. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_stopwatch.setting.key.d: Change it in Options > Controls > Key Binds, under Swift Client.
swift.module.hud_stopwatch.setting.reset: Optional key that puts the stopwatch back to zero.
Put the stopwatch back to zero now.
swift.module.hud_togglestatus.name: Toggle Sneak/Sprint
swift.module.hud_togglestatus.desc: Shows when you are sprinting or sneaking, and whether it is toggled. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.fire.name: Fire
swift.module.fire.desc: The flames on your screen when you burn: lower, more transparent, or gone.
swift.module.fire.setting.hide.name: Hide completely
swift.module.fire.setting.hide.desc: No flames at all on your screen. You still see yourself burning in third person.
swift.module.fire.setting.height.name: Lower by
swift.module.fire.setting.height.desc: How far the flames are pushed down the screen.
swift.module.fire.setting.opacity.name: Opacity
swift.module.hud_playtime.name: Playtime
swift.module.hud_playtime.desc: How long you have been in this world or server. Move it in the HUD Editor.
Prefix the time with the word "Playtime".
swift.module.better_foliage.name: Better Foliage
swift.module.better_foliage.desc: Grass, mycelium and podzol covered on their sides too: hills look like one continuous carpet.
swift.module.nick_hider.name: Nick Hider
swift.module.nick_hider.desc: Replaces your name with a nickname everywhere on your screen, for videos and streams. Others still see your real name.
swift.module.nick_hider.setting.nick.des: The name shown instead of yours.
swift.module.titles.name: Titles
swift.module.titles.desc: The big titles servers show in the middle of the screen: smaller, higher, or hidden.
swift.module.titles.setting.scale.name: Size
swift.module.titles.setting.scale.desc: Size of titles and subtitles. 100% is vanilla.
swift.module.titles.setting.offset.name: Height
swift.module.titles.setting.offset.desc: How far above the centre of the screen they appear.
swift.module.titles.setting.hide_subtitl: Never show the smaller line under it.
swift.module.hud_packs.name: Pack Display
swift.module.hud_packs.desc: The resource packs you are using. Move it in the HUD Editor.
swift.module.hud_packs.setting.max.name: Max packs
swift.module.hud_packs.setting.max.desc: How many packs are listed, starting from the top one.
swift.module.screenshot.name: Screenshot
swift.module.screenshot.desc: Screenshots (F2) are copied to your clipboard, ready to paste on Discord, and confirmed with a notification.
swift.module.screenshot.setting.clipboar: Copy every screenshot so you can paste it right away (Windows, macOS, Linux with xclip).
swift.module.screenshot.setting.quiet.de: Do not write "Saved screenshot as..." in the chat. The Notifications module still confirms it.
swift.module.mod_menu.name: Mod Menu
swift.module.mod_menu.desc: Shortcuts to this menu: its key, and the Mods / Cosmetics / Language links of the pause menu.
swift.module.mod_menu.setting.key.name: Menu key
swift.module.mod_menu.setting.key.desc: Key that opens this menu in game. Change it in Options > Controls > Key Binds.
swift.module.mod_menu.setting.pause_link: Show the Mods, Cosmetics and Language links at the bottom of the pause menu.

swift.friends.title: Friends
